trello.desc: Diego, get the contract through legal review and signed by end of next week, and confirm the AV package includes recording in all three rooms, last year we lost the breakout talks because recording was main-hall only.

trello.name: Lock speaker lineup in two weeks
trello.desc: I'll send final follow-ups to the two maybes with a decision deadline of Friday, and I have a backup list of five names if either falls through. Worst case I fill the third slot from the backup list. Either way I'll have the lineup locked in two weeks so we can print the agenda.

trello.name: Chase keynote abstract from Dr. Osei
trello.desc: I'll chase Dr. Osei for the keynote abstract this week, we need it for the website and the printed program.

trello.name: Run three-wave email campaign
trello.desc: I'll run the email campaign in three waves: agenda announcement when Bo locks the lineup, early-bird deadline reminder two weeks before the price change, and a final-week push. I'll draft all three this month, and the first wave goes out the day the agenda is live.

trello.name: Hand off speaker bios and headshots same day for website update
trello.desc: Bo, once the lineup locks, hand the bios and headshots straight to Diego for the landing page update, same day, don't sit on them.

trello.desc: Order's ready to place: 800 shirts across sizes, 500 notebooks, 1,000 stickers, comes to about 9,200 with the rush buffer. I just need your sign-off on the design proofs, they're in the shared drive.

trello.name: Review swag design proofs and place order this week
trello.desc: I'll review the proofs today, and once I approve, you place the order this week, lead time was six weeks last year, we're already cutting it close.
